about.title: About FreePics
about.subtitle: An AI-powered, free 4K wallpaper sharing platform
about.missionBody: Every day, FreePics.cc uses cutting-edge AI image generation models — including Flux, SDXL, and more — to automatically create stunning ultra-HD wallpapers across styles from realistic landscapes and cyberpunk cityscapes to anime illustrations. We believe high-quality digital art should be accessible to everyone — always free, no watermarks, fully transparent.
about.featureAIDesc: Built on Flux, SDXL and other frontier models with SUPIR 4K upscaling for cinema-quality results
about.featureDualDesc: Every wallpaper in both 16:9 landscape (desktop) and 9:16 portrait (mobile) formats
about.featureFreeDesc: No watermarks, no ads. AVIF downloads are instant, 4K originals available with a free account
about.featureParamsDesc: Every image includes its complete prompt, model, sampler, and generation parameters for creators to learn from
about.supportBody: FreePics runs entirely on community support. If you enjoy our wallpapers, consider buying us a coffee! Every contribution goes toward server costs and creating more amazing content for everyone.
